search.website_text:
A simple FFXIV Dalamud auto-presser: press a key N times or unlimited at a chosen delay. Works while tabbed out. # AutoClicker

A simple auto-presser for FFXIV (Dalamud plugin). Pick a keyboard key and it presses it for you
— a set number of times, or unlimited until you stop it — at whatever delay you choose.

The key is sent **to FFXIV only** (never to other windows) and keeps working **while the game is
tabbed out**, so you can leave it running in the background.

## Features

- **Pick any key** — click *Set key*, then press the key you want it to spam.
- **How many times** — a set number, or **Unlimited (until stopped)**.
- **Delay between presses** — in seconds (e.g. `3.1` = press once every 3.1 seconds).
- **Start delay** — a one-time countdown before the first press.
- **Start/stop hotkey** — a separate global key to start/stop without the mouse (works even while
  tabbed out). Must be different from the key being pressed.
- `/autoclick` opens the window; `/autoclick start | stop | toggle` control it directly.

## Installing (custom repository — recommended)

AutoClicker is distributed as a Dalamud **custom plugin repository**, so you can install it and get
automatic updates from the in-game installer:

1. In game: `/xlsettings` → **Experimental** tab.
2. Under **Custom Plugin Repositories**, paste this URL into the empty row and click the **+**:

   ```
   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jlynn209/AutoClicker/main/pluginmaster.json
   ```

3. Click **Save**.
4. Open `/xlplugins`, search **AutoClicker**, and click **Install**.
5. Run `/autoclick`.

> Third-party plugins are not affiliated with or endorsed by Dalamud/XIVLauncher. Only add
> repositories you trust.

## How it works / tips

- Pick a key that's actually **bound to something in game** (e.g. a hotbar slot) or the press won't
  do anything visible.
- For background use, keep FFXIV **not minimized** (windowed/borderless behind another window, or on
  a second monitor). A fully minimized client may throttle input processing, and the game's
  *"Limit frame rate when client is not active"* setting caps how fast it can press in the background
  (irrelevant for multi-second delays).
- Set a **Start/stop hotkey** so you always have a panic-stop, especially in Unlimited mode.

## Building from source

You need the **.NET 10 SDK** (this plugin targets `net10.0-windows` for Dalamud API 15).

```bash
dotnet build AutoClicker.sln -c Release
```

The build references Dalamud from your local dev folder (`%AppData%\XIVLauncher\addon\Hooks\dev`).
It produces the plugin assembly at `AutoClicker\bin\Release\AutoClicker.dll` and a packaged copy
(manifest + zip) at `AutoClicker\bin\Release\AutoClicker\`.

## Installing (dev / testing)

1. In game, open Dalamud settings: `/xlsettings` → **Experimental**.
2. Under **Dev Plugin Locations**, add the folder containing the built DLL:
   `...\AutoClicker\bin\Release`
3. Open `/xlplugins` → enable AutoClicker (or reload dev plugins).
4. Run `/autoclick`.

## Note

Automating input may run afoul of the game's Terms of Service. Use at your own discretion.
